text:
maria: heads-up — ACME reporting console shows zero 'tenant-hours' for past 3 hours (10:00-13:00 UTC). Customer ticket open. @ajay @kevin can you take a look? https://console.redwood.ai/insights/acme/usage :eyes:

ops-bot: ALERT: ingest-consumer 'usage-agg' group lagging (lag=1.2M messages), last commit 2026-03-16T09:58Z :warning:

ajay: digging in kafka consumer logs — offsets appear stuck, seeing OffsetOutOfRangeException in the consumer loop. snippet:
```2026-03-16T10:03:12Z ERROR consumer OffsetOutOfRangeException partition=12 position=...```

kevin: I pushed a minor deserialization change to ingest-consumer earlier. could be schema drift. Suggest a rolling restart: `kubectl -n analytics rollout restart deploy/ingest-consumer`

maria: do we risk double-processing if we restart + backfill? customer wants ETA.

ajay: restart should unstick the group. backfill required for the missing 10:00-13:00 window. plan: 1) restart consumer 2) reprocess offsets into backfill queue 3) run backfill with idempotency. dry-run command: `./scripts/backfill_usage.py --tenant acme --start 2026-03-16T10:00Z --end 2026-03-16T13:00Z --dry-run`

kevin: add `--idempotent` when you run live to avoid duplicates. also pause dashboard alerts for ACME while we replay: `console-admin pause_alerts --scope tenant:acme`

maria: :thumbsup: I'll tell the customer ETA ~2h for consumer restart + ~2h for backfill. can someone run the restart and confirm logs?

ajay: restarting now, tailing logs: `kubectl -n analytics logs -f deploy/ingest-consumer --since=5m`

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT EVENT: ingest-consumer restarted by ajay at 2026-03-16T10:12Z

ajay: consumer is back up; lag dropping from 1.2M -> 0.2M. OffsetOutOfRange errors gone, see a deserialization warning: `missing field 'context.v2'`. this is non-fatal, ok to proceed if we use idempotent backfill.

kevin: starting dry-run backfill now to validate data shape: `./scripts/backfill_usage.py --tenant acme --start 2026-03-16T10:00Z --end 2026-03-16T13:00Z --idempotent --dry-run`

maria: updating support ticket: "Investigating ingest consumer lag; restart done, backfill dry-run in progress. ETA full recovery ~4 hours." tagging #support-escalations

ajay: dry-run looks good — estimated ~120k rows to import for ACME. scheduling live backfill in 10m.

kevin: launching live backfill (job-5234) now, monitoring token counts and SLOs.

ops-bot: BACKFILL JOB: job-5234 started by kevin at 2026-03-16T10:45Z

maria: great — once job finishes, we'll verify dashboard shows tenant-hours for 10:00-13:00 UTC and close the ticket. thanks all :white_check_mark:
